introduction: AgentKit's root package lets an embedder choose what runs an agent by provider name (anthropic, openrouter or ollama), model (a tier or the provider's own model id) and effort. The agent resolves these through the catalog and builds the provider's client itself. Each provider reads only its own variables. The same resolution is exported as `agentkit.Resolve`, the agent reports what it used, and a run whose cost cannot be known is flagged in `core.Usage`.

glossary.Listed: True when the resolved model id has its own catalog row, false when the provider's fallback row was used.
glossary.Resolution: The value returned by agentkit.Resolve and Agent.Resolution: canonical provider name, tier, catalog model row, normalized effort, Listed flag and the core.ProviderClient a run calls.
glossary.cost bit: The core.UsageCostUSD bit in Usage.Set, which marks CostUSD as present.
glossary.lookup order: How a credential or endpoint variable is read: a non-empty Config.Env value first, then Config.Getenv when set (no process fallback), otherwise the process environment. An empty value counts as unset.
glossary.recording server: An httptest server in a test that answers one canned text turn in a provider's wire format and records every request's path, headers and body.
glossary.tier: A catalog tier name such as STANDARD that maps, per provider, to a model id and a default effort (spec 26).
glossary.unpriced: A usage covering at least one request whose cost neither the vendor reported nor the catalog priced, so CostUSD counts it as zero; carried as core.Usage.Unpriced.

requirements.title: The Config fields that choose a model
requirements.rationale: A provider name selects a built-in provider without a registry, and an SDK-typed field would be Anthropic-only.

criteria.action: declare exactly fourteen exported fields in this order: Client core.ProviderClient, Provider string, Model string, Effort Effort, Env map[string]string, Getenv func(string) string, System, Prefix, Toolset, MaxTurns, MaxCostUSD, Timeout, Prune, MaxTokens, with the last eight keeping their current types
criteria.contract: reflect.TypeOf(agentkit.Config{}) lists exactly these fourteen field names and types in this order

criteria.action: match Config.Provider after trimming surrounding whitespace and without regard to case, treat an empty Provider as anthropic, and report the canonical lower-case name in Resolution.Provider
criteria.contract: Provider " OpenRouter " resolves to Resolution.Provider "openrouter"; Provider "" resolves to "anthropic"

criteria.condition: a credential or endpoint variable is looked up for the chosen provider
criteria.action: use a non-empty Config.Env value first, otherwise call Config.Getenv when it is set without falling back to the process environment, otherwise read the process environment, treating an empty value at any step as unset
criteria.contract: with Env {"OPENROUTER_API_KEY": ""} and Getenv returning "k" for that name, the provider receives key "k"; with Getenv set, a process-environment value is never used

criteria.action: import neither github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go nor any of its sub-packages from non-test code
criteria.contract: `go list -f '{{.Imports}}' github.com/agent-fox-dev/agentkit-go` lists no path starting with github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go

requirements.title: agentkit.Resolve: from a config to what will run
requirements.rationale: An embedder must be able to see, check or wrap exactly what New would use without building an agent.

criteria.condition: agentkit.Resolve(cfg) is called with a valid provider, model and effort
criteria.action: call catalog.Select(cfg.Provider, cfg.Model, cfg.Effort) and return a Resolution whose Provider, Tier, Model, Effort and Listed equal the Selection's fields and whose Client is the client a run would call
criteria.contract: (Resolution, nil); Tier is empty when a model id was named; Effort is the normalized effort and empty means none is sent

criteria.condition: catalog.Select returns an error, including when Config.Client is set
criteria.action: return that error unchanged without building a client or reading any variable
criteria.contract: (zero Resolution, err) where errors.Is(err, catalog.ErrUnknownProvider), catalog.ErrNoModel or catalog.ErrUnknownEffort holds and the message names the rejected value and the valid choices

criteria.action: for any Config, return a Resolution that depends only on Client, Provider, Model, Effort, Env and Getenv, such that two calls with the same config return equal Provider, Tier, Model, Effort and Listed, and changing System, Prefix, Toolset, MaxTurns, MaxCostUSD, Timeout, Prune or MaxTokens changes none of them
criteria.contract: two Resolve calls on configs differing only in the non-selection fields return Resolutions with equal Provider, Tier, Model, Effort and Listed

criteria.action: send no network request and keep no package-level state, building a new client on each call when Config.Client is nil
criteria.contract: recording servers count zero requests after any number of successful Resolve calls; two calls return distinct Client values

requirements.title: Building the provider client and checking credentials
requirements.rationale: Credentials are checked before a run so a misconfigured agent fails at construction, not on its first request.

criteria.condition: Resolve runs with Config.Client nil
criteria.action: first call anthropic.Resolve over an anthropic.Env that applies the lookup order, then return anthropic.Provider(Resolution.Model, anthropic.Options{Env: cfg.Env, Getenv: cfg.Getenv}) as Resolution.Client
criteria.contract: Resolution.Client is the provider built with Options{Env, Getenv}, not with the resolved SDK client

criteria.condition: the provider is anthropic and anthropic.Resolve fails, for example with no Anthropic credential or a Vertex selection without a project
criteria.action: return the error of anthropic.Resolve unchanged
criteria.contract: (zero Resolution, err) with errors.Is(err, anthropic.ErrNoCredentials) when no credential is set; the Vertex error names both project variables

criteria.condition: Resolve runs with Config.Client nil
criteria.action: return openrouter.New(Resolution.Model, openrouter.Options{Env: cfg.Env, Getenv: cfg.Getenv}) as Resolution.Client

criteria.condition: the provider is openrouter and openrouter.New fails, for example because OPENROUTER_API_KEY is missing or OPENROUTER_BASE_URL is malformed
criteria.action: return the error of openrouter.New unchanged
criteria.contract: (zero Resolution, err) with errors.Is(err, openrouter.ErrNoAPIKey) when the key is missing

criteria.condition: Resolve runs with Config.Client nil
criteria.action: return ollama.New(Resolution.Model, ollama.Options{Env: cfg.Env, Getenv: cfg.Getenv}) as Resolution.Client, requiring no credential and returning any constructor error unchanged
criteria.contract: with no variable set, (Resolution, nil)

criteria.condition: Config.Client is set
criteria.action: return that client as Resolution.Client without building a provider and without reading any variable
criteria.contract: Getenv is called zero times and Env is not consulted; Provider and Model still choose Resolution.Model and Resolution.Effort

criteria.condition: the chosen provider's host is unreachable
criteria.action: succeed without contacting the host, so the failure surfaces from the run's first model request
criteria.contract: Resolve and New return nil error; Agent.Run returns the transport error of the first request

requirements.title: Credential and endpoint isolation
requirements.rationale: A secret meant for one vendor must never be sent to another.

criteria.action: perform every variable lookup through the chosen provider's own code only, so the injected Getenv is asked only for names belonging to the chosen provider's variable set and no value read for one provider is passed to another provider's client
criteria.contract: for each provider, the set of names passed to Getenv during Resolve and one run contains no OpenRouter, Ollama or Anthropic variable belonging to a different provider

criteria.action: never read AGENTKIT_PROVIDER, AGENTKIT_MODEL, AGENTKIT_EFFORT or any other variable whose name starts with AGENTKIT_
criteria.contract: no name starting with AGENTKIT_ is passed to Getenv during Resolve, New or a run

criteria.condition: an agent runs one prompt on a chosen provider
criteria.guard: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OLLAMA_API_KEY are all set and each provider's base-URL variable points at its own recording server
criteria.action: send requests only to the chosen provider's recording server
criteria.contract: the other two recording servers count zero requests

criteria.action: for any ordered pair of distinct providers (P, Q), never place a secret of Q in any header or body of a request sent while running on P, and never send OLLAMA_API_KEY to any server
criteria.contract: no recorded header value or body on any server contains another provider's secret string or the OLLAMA_API_KEY value

requirements.title: agentkit.New builds on the resolution
requirements.rationale: New is Resolve plus the tool side, so what Resolve reports is exactly what the agent uses.

criteria.condition: agentkit.New(cfg) is called
criteria.action: run Resolve(cfg) before validating cfg.Toolset with NewRunner, so errors are reported in the order provider, model, effort, credentials, tool set
criteria.contract: a config with both an unknown provider and an invalid tool set returns catalog.ErrUnknownProvider; a config with missing credentials and an invalid tool set returns the credential error

criteria.condition: Resolve or NewRunner fails inside New
criteria.action: return the error unchanged and send no request
criteria.contract: (nil, err) with the same error value Resolve or NewRunner returned; every recording server counts zero requests

criteria.action: call Resolution.Client for every model request and use Resolution.Model as the row for pruning, the context-window check, pricing and message stamping
put Resolution.Effort on every model request instead of the raw Config.Effort
criteria.contract: a tier's effort is sent when Config.Effort is empty; Config.Effort "HIGH" is sent as high; an empty Resolution.Effort sends no effort

criteria.condition: Config.Model is a tier name
criteria.action: name the tier's resolved model id wherever it names its model, including AgentStartEvent.Model, assistant message stamping and the context-window error
criteria.contract: none of these carries the tier name

criteria.condition: an agent built with Provider openrouter, Model STANDARD and Getenv supplying OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL runs one prompt
criteria.action: send a request whose body carries model qwen/qwen3.8-flash and reasoning.effort medium to POST <base>/chat/completions
criteria.contract: Agent.Resolution() reports Provider openrouter, Tier STANDARD, Model.ID qwen/qwen3.8-flash, Effort medium, Listed true

criteria.condition: an agent built with Provider ollama, Model STANDARD and Getenv supplying OLLAMA_HOST runs one prompt
criteria.action: send a request to /api/chat whose body carries model qwen3.8:27b, think medium and options.num_ctx 32768
criteria.contract: Agent.Resolution() reports Provider ollama, Tier STANDARD, Model.ID qwen3.8:27b, Effort medium, Listed true

requirements.title: Reporting what runs
requirements.rationale: A caller holding only the agent, such as a logger or budget gate, must be able to say what ran.

criteria.action: return the Resolution the agent was built with, whose Provider, Tier, Model, Effort, Listed and Client equal those of Resolve on the same config
return a copy, so writing to the returned Model.Efforts map or Model.Compat bytes leaves the agent's own row and later Resolution() results unchanged

criteria.condition: a run is in progress on another goroutine
criteria.action: return without a data race
criteria.contract: `go test -race` reports no race when Resolution() is called concurrently with Run

criteria.action: export exactly seven methods: Messages, ReachableTools, Resolution, Run, Runner, Stream and Usage

criteria.condition: a run starts
criteria.action: emit a core.AgentStartEvent whose Provider is the resolved provider name, Model is the resolved model id, and API is the API constant of the provider package Resolve built (anthropic.API, openrouter.API or ollama.API)
criteria.contract: AgentStartEvent{Provider, API, Model} all non-empty when Resolve built the client

criteria.condition: Config.Client was given
criteria.action: emit AgentStartEvent with an empty API while still filling Provider and Model from the resolution
criteria.contract: AgentStartEvent.API == ""

requirements.title: Runs whose cost is unknown
requirements.rationale: A zero cost from an unpriced model must be distinguishable from a free run, and the cost bit alone cannot carry that through Add.

criteria.action: for any two usages a and b, after a.Add(b) have a.Unpriced equal to the logical OR of the two prior Unpriced values, with every other field combined as today
carry Usage.Unpriced under the JSON key unpriced, present on every encoded usage
criteria.contract: the encoded event JSON of a usage with Unpriced true contains "unpriced":true; with false it contains "unpriced":false

criteria.condition: the agent prices a turn whose usage was reported (Usage.Reported())
criteria.guard: the resolved model has all four per-million rates at zero and either the resolved provider is anthropic, or it is openrouter and the response left the cost bit clear
criteria.action: mark that turn's priced usage Unpriced
criteria.contract: an Anthropic run on an unlisted id that reported usage, and an OpenRouter run on an unlisted id whose response carried no cost, end with RunResult.Usage.Unpriced true

criteria.condition: the resolved provider is ollama, whichever client is called
criteria.action: never mark a turn Unpriced
criteria.contract: RunResult.Usage.Unpriced is false for every Ollama run

criteria.action: leave Unpriced false for a turn on a model with any non-zero per-million rate, for an OpenRouter response that set the cost bit, and for a turn whose usage was not reported
propagate an Unpriced turn to RunResult.Usage, AgentDoneEvent.Result.Usage, AgentDoneEvent.Usage and Agent.Usage(), leaving TurnEndEvent.Usage as the provider's own usage of that turn
price an unpriced turn as today, setting the computed cost of zero with the cost bit set, and keep MaxCostUSD reading CostUSD
criteria.contract: an unpriced turn has CostUSD 0 and Has(core.UsageCostUSD) true; MaxCostUSD stop behaviour is unchanged

requirements.title: Existing behaviour and migration
requirements.rationale: Anthropic callers and test doubles must see no behaviour change beyond the mechanical field rename.

criteria.condition: an agent is built with Provider empty or anthropic and Model claude-opus-5-5 and runs one prompt
criteria.action: send a request body byte-identical to the one sent by anthropic.Provider(row, anthropic.Options{Env, Getenv}) built directly with the same environment

criteria.condition: Provider is empty or anthropic and Model is an unlisted Claude id
criteria.action: resolve Resolution.Model to the same row catalog.Lookup returns for that id, with Listed false, so pruning, pricing and stop behaviour are unchanged
criteria.contract: reflect.DeepEqual(res.Model, catalog.Lookup(id) row) and res.Listed == false

criteria.condition: a test double such as provider/faux is passed as Config.Client
criteria.action: call that client for every request, so every existing test in the root, codemode, sandbox and example modules passes after renaming Provider: to Client: with no other assertion change
criteria.contract: `make test` passes across every module in MODULES

criteria.condition: examples/codingagent, examples/customtools or examples/mcp start with no Anthropic credential set
criteria.action: fail from agentkit.New before any request, reporting the variables to set, without resolving an SDK client of its own
criteria.contract: non-zero exit with an error message naming ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; the program source imports no github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go package

requirements.title: Exported API record
requirements.rationale: The exported-API golden is the contract later specs and embedders compare against.

criteria.action: record in the root section the fourteen-field Config, func Resolve(cfg Config) (Resolution, error), type Resolution and method (*Agent) Resolution() Resolution, and in the core section Usage.Unpriced and UsageJSON's unpriced field, with every other section unchanged
criteria.contract: the golden comparison test of internal/policy passes against the regenerated internal/policy/testdata/exported-api.golden

criteria.action: keep the Config line ending with the substring `Prefix []core.Message Toolset Toolset MaxTurns int MaxCostUSD float64 Timeout time.Duration Prune PruneOptions MaxTokens int }`
criteria.contract: the Config line of internal/policy/testdata/exported-api.golden contains the substring, so TS-21-55 passes

execution_paths.title: An embedder runs an agent on OpenRouter by name

steps.action: calls agentkit.New(Config{Provider: "openrouter", Model: "STANDARD", Getenv: …}) with OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL pointing at a recording server
calls catalog.Select and openrouter.New with Env and Getenv, returning a Resolution with model qwen/qwen3.8-flash and effort medium
runs one prompt, emits AgentStartEvent{Provider: openrouter, API: openrouter.API, Model: qwen/qwen3.8-flash} and sends the request with reasoning.effort medium
records one POST /chat/completions and answers a text turn whose usage carries no cost
returns RunResult whose Usage.Unpriced is false for the listed row, and Agent.Resolution() reports Listed true

execution_paths.title: An embedder runs an agent on Ollama by name

steps.action: calls agentkit.New(Config{Provider: "ollama", Model: "STANDARD", Getenv: …}) with OLLAMA_HOST pointing at a recording server and no credential
calls catalog.Select and ollama.New, returning a Resolution with model qwen3.8:27b and effort medium
runs one prompt and sends POST /api/chat with think medium and options.num_ctx 32768
records the request and answers an NDJSON text turn ending with done true
returns RunResult with Usage.Unpriced false and AgentStartEvent.Provider ollama

execution_paths.title: An Anthropic run stays byte-identical and flags an unlisted model as unpriced

steps.action: calls agentkit.New(Config{Model: "claude-opus-5-5", Getenv: …}) with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointing at a recording server
runs anthropic.Resolve to check the credential, then builds anthropic.Provider with Options{Env, Getenv}
runs one prompt and sends a request body byte-identical to a directly built anthropic.Provider's
repeats with an unlisted Claude id whose server response reports usage
returns RunResult whose Usage.Unpriced is true with CostUSD 0 and the cost bit set

execution_paths.title: Provider isolation across all three providers

steps.action: sets all three providers' secrets in a recording Getenv and points each base-URL variable at its own recording server
builds and runs an agent on anthropic, then openrouter, then ollama
lets only the chosen provider's code look up variables
record requests only on the chosen provider's server, with no other provider's secret in any header or body
checks that Getenv was asked for no other provider's variable and no AGENTKIT_ variable

execution_paths.title: An embedder resolves, wraps and passes its own client

steps.action: calls agentkit.Resolve(cfg) with Provider openrouter and a model id
returns the Resolution with the built client and sends no request
sets cfg.Client to a wrapper around res.Client and calls agentkit.New(cfg)
uses the given client and reads no variable
runs one prompt through the wrapper and emits AgentStartEvent with Provider openrouter and an empty API
